concurrency_and_state: Controller.handleClientJoinMap (Controller.java:1120) is synchronized on the Controller singleton, serializing all player map-join initialization, DB/network sends, and scheduled tasks globally.
Controller.onMessage case -74 type==2 (Controller.java:551) spawns an unbounded raw Thread ("SendRes-" + ip) per packet without authentication or rate limit.

PacketProfiler.DATE_FORMAT and DAY_FORMAT (PacketProfiler.java:49-50) are static non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat instances accessed concurrently by Netty IO threads in record() and PacketProfiler-Scheduler in exportSummaryCsv().

PacketProfiler.triggerPerformanceAlert (PacketProfiler.java:202-205) is synchronized and writes tools/memory/PERFORMANCE_ALERTS.json synchronously on the Netty IO thread for every critical slow packet even if the alert is already open.

GameLoopManager.run (GameLoopManager.java:260-271) caches players.size() before iterating Client.gI().getPlayers() without snapshot/lock, risking IndexOutOfBoundsException that aborts map/zone updates for that tick.

GameLoopManager schedules 4 independent periodic tasks (run 1000ms, updateBosses 250ms, updateEventBosses 1000ms, updatePhoBans 1000ms) across a ScheduledThreadPool concurrently mutating Zone/Player/Boss state.
Maintenance.isRunning (Maintenance.java:8) is non-volatile static boolean read across Netty, GameLoop, and ServerNotify threads; Maintenance.start() is unsynchronized and extends Thread.
ServerNotify.notifies (ServerNotify.java:14,46-47,70) is an unsynchronized ArrayList mutated by arbitrary threads via notify() and polled/removed by ServerNotify thread via removeFirst().

Manager.reloadData (Manager.java:204-254) clears and reloads all global static collections (MAPS, ITEM_TEMPLATES, CLANS, etc.) in place without setting ServerManager.isReloading=true or locking readers.

ServerManager.CLIENTS (ServerManager.java:46) is a ConcurrentHashMap updated atomically via compute/computeIfPresent; ServerManager.close() sets isRunning=false before calling cleanupResources(), bypassing cleanupResources()'s parallel player-save block (line 393).
cross_module_questions: Does Client.gI().getPlayers() return a live unsynchronized ArrayList or a thread-safe CopyOnWriteArrayList/snapshot, and does Client.gI().close() already save all online players before ServerManager.cleanupResources() runs?

In Controller.java cases 54 and -60, is player.lastTimeAttack updated atomically inside Service.attackMob / Service.attackPlayer, and are those methods thread-safe against concurrent Netty/GameLoop access?
Are TransactionService.gI().controller and CombineService.gI().showInfoCombine properly synchronized when invoked from Netty worker threads?

Does PlayerDAO.updatePlayer(player) called from ServerManager.startAutoSaveTask and shutdown hooks safely snapshot player inventory/skills/pet while GameLoopManager and Netty threads mutate the same Player object?

In Manager.java SQL queries (lines 172-185), is the player column named dien_sukien or diem_sukien in the MySQL schema, and does player table have a UNIQUE constraint on name to prevent TOCTOU duplicates in Controller.createChar?
Does NettyServer / Message lifecycle handle Message.cleanup()/dispose() properly if an exception escapes Controller.onMessage's finally block (e.g. from PacketProfiler.record)?

db_redis_touchpoints.op: AlyraManager.executeQuery("select * from player where name = ?", name) + PlayerDAO.createNewPlayer(...)
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Manual rs.dispose() in finally instead of try-with-resources; checks mixed-case name then inserts name.toLowerCase(); TOCTOU race between check and insert.
Blocking JDBC calls executed directly on Netty IO/packet handler thread inside sendInfo().
Uses try-with-resources; however queryTopSM (line 162) joins p.id = a.id instead of p.account_id = a.id, breaking admin exclusion; queryTopNap uses rs.getInt("danap") risking int overflow.
PlayerDAO.updatePlayer runs in auto-save and parallel virtual threads during shutdown without per-player lock against live mutations.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: AlyraManager.executeQuery("SELECT id, password FROM account") + loop AlyraManager.executeUpdate("UPDATE account SET password = ? WHERE id = ?")
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Manual rs.dispose(); loads all accounts into HashMap then issues N+1 updates on background thread after startup while logins may already occur.

findings.impact: Any normal player can teleport arbitrarily across the map (bypassing both 80ms rate-limit and speed/distance anti-cheat) by sending MOVE coordinates within 150px of any mob in the zone, even without TDLT.
findings.root_cause: isNearMobInZone trusts client-supplied (toX, toY) and checks if any mob in player.zone.mobs is within 150px, bypassing both rate-limit (line 503) and distance check (line 507) for all players, not just TDLT users.
findings.title: Client-trusted coordinates bypass anti-speed/teleport check in MOVE (-7)

findings.impact: Concurrent SimpleDateFormat usage across Netty IO threads and scheduler corrupts date strings or throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException/NumberFormatException inside Controller.onMessage's finally block (uncaught).
findings.root_cause: Static non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat instances (DATE_FORMAT, DAY_FORMAT) are shared without synchronization or ThreadLocal across Netty worker threads in record() and PacketProfiler-Scheduler.
findings.title: Non-thread-safe SimpleDateFormat on Netty IO hot path in PacketProfiler

findings.impact: Once a command exceeds criticalThreshold, every subsequent slow packet for that command acquires the PacketProfiler monitor and synchronously rewrites PERFORMANCE_ALERTS.json on the Netty IO thread, stalling network processing.
findings.root_cause: triggerPerformanceAlert() is synchronized and calls synchronous FileWriter I/O (syncAlertsJson) directly from record() on the Netty IO thread without checking if the alert is already active or offloading to the background writer.
findings.title: Synchronous disk I/O and global lock on Netty IO thread in PacketProfiler.triggerPerformanceAlert

findings.impact: Causes ConcurrentModificationException, lost server-wide VIP notifications, or corrupted ArrayList state under concurrent calls to ServerNotify.notify().
findings.root_cause: notifies is a plain ArrayList modified concurrently by caller threads in notify() and polled via removeFirst() on the ServerNotify thread without synchronization.
findings.title: Unsynchronized ArrayList race condition in ServerNotify.notifies

findings.impact: If players leave during the loop and Client.gI().getPlayers() is a live list, players.get(i) throws IndexOutOfBoundsException, skipping player updates and aborting all Map/Zone updates for that tick.
findings.root_cause: GameLoopManager.run() caches players.size() before iterating without locking or copying, and only wraps individual player.update() calls in try-catch, not players.get(i).
findings.title: Unprotected list iteration in GameLoopManager.run() can skip all Zone updates

findings.impact: Unauthenticated clients spamming opcode -74 (type 2) can spawn unlimited JVM threads ("SendRes-" + ip), causing Thread/OOM DoS; pre-login clients sending opcode 127 or -76 trigger NPEs.
findings.root_cause: case -74 spawns a raw unbounded Thread without session auth or rate limiting; case 127 and case -76 dereference player without checking player != null.
findings.title: Unauthenticated thread-spawn DoS (-74) and missing player null-checks (127, -76) in Controller

findings.impact: TOP Sức Mạnh leaderboard fails to exclude admin accounts whose account.id != player.id and wrongly excludes normal players whose player.id happens to match an admin's account.id.
findings.root_cause: queryTopSM joins `LEFT JOIN account a ON p.id = a.id AND a.is_admin = 1` instead of joining on `p.account_id = a.id`.
findings.title: Wrong JOIN key in Manager.queryTopSM breaks admin exclusion

findings.impact: Clearing global lists/maps in reloadData() while Netty and GameLoop threads read them causes NPE, IndexOutOfBoundsException, or ConcurrentModificationException across live sessions.
findings.root_cause: reloadData() clears MAPS, ITEM_TEMPLATES, MOB_TEMPLATES, CLANS, SHOPS, NOTIFY in place without setting ServerManager.isReloading=true or synchronizing readers.
findings.title: Unsafe in-place clear in Manager.reloadData() without isReloading guard or locks

findings.impact: Leaks a FileInputStream file descriptor on server startup and on every reloadData() call.
findings.root_cause: properties.load(new FileInputStream("data/config/alyra.properties")) does not close the FileInputStream via try-with-resources.
findings.title: Unclosed FileInputStream in Manager.loadProperties()

findings.impact: Other threads reading Maintenance.isRunning may observe stale false values due to missing volatile; two concurrent start() calls can throw IllegalThreadStateException; start(int min) actually treats argument as seconds.
findings.root_cause: isRunning lacks volatile, start() lacks synchronization, and countdown loop decrements time by 1 per 1000ms despite parameter name `min`.
findings.title: Non-volatile Maintenance.isRunning and seconds/minutes unit mismatch

findings.impact: All players joining a map serialize on the Controller singleton lock while executing DB queries, mapInfo, and Netty sends; sendInfo also executes blocking SuperRankDAO JDBC queries on Netty thread.
findings.root_cause: handleClientJoinMap is declared `synchronized` on Controller.gI() instead of per-player synchronization; sendInfo performs synchronous SuperRankDAO calls on packet thread.
findings.title: Global Controller singleton lock in handleClientJoinMap and blocking DAO in sendInfo

findings.impact: NullPointerException when player.zone is null during Calick menu selection, openMenuNPC, spaceship teleport (-105 type 2), or return home (-15).
findings.root_cause: Dereferences player.zone.map without checking player.zone != null (and MenuController.openMenuNPC dereferences player before any null check).
findings.title: Missing player/zone null checks in MenuController and Controller map cases

findings.impact: Mixed-case ignored names bypass IGNORE_NAME check; negative byte in combine (-81) throws NegativeArraySizeException; duplicate/non-atomic check-then-insert on createChar.
findings.root_cause: createChar compares mixed-case name against DB and ConstIgnoreName before calling name.toLowerCase() during insert; case -81 passes readByte() directly as array length without >= 0 validation.
findings.title: Input validation & case-normalization mismatch in Controller createChar and Combine (-81)

findings.impact: ServerPacketDispatcher only handles -86 and -20 while those same opcodes remain as dead branches in Controller.java, increasing maintenance confusion and bypassing dispatcher symmetry.
findings.root_cause: Partial refactoring left 50+ opcodes in Controller.onMessage and duplicated case -86 and case -20 after ServerPacketDispatcher.dispatch().
findings.title: Incomplete ServerPacketDispatcher migration with dead duplicate opcodes in Controller

findings.impact: When Maintenance triggers ServerManager.close(), cleanupResources() skips its parallel player-save block because isRunning was already set to false at line 330; System.exit(0) also triggers cleanupResources() a second time via shutdown hook.
findings.root_cause: close() sets isRunning=false before invoking cleanupResources(), whose player-save block is gated on `if (isRunning)`.
findings.title: ServerManager.close() bypasses cleanupResources() player-save guard and double-invokes cleanup

findings.impact: queryTopNap reads danap as 32-bit int (overflows above ~2.14B VND); migratePasswordsToBCrypt issues N+1 sequential UPDATE statements on startup while server accepts logins.
findings.root_cause: rs.getInt("danap") instead of getLong; migratePasswordsToBCrypt loops over all accounts issuing individual executeUpdate calls.
findings.title: 32-bit int risk in Manager.queryTopNap and N+1 updates in BCrypt migration

key_classes.name: GameLoopManager
key_classes.responsibility: ScheduledExecutorService driving 1000ms player/zone/phoban/event-boss ticks and 250ms combat boss ticks.

key_classes.name: ImageResizeManager
key_classes.responsibility: Startup background utility resizing PNG icons from data/icon/x4 to x3, x2, and x1 using ImageIO/Graphics2D.

key_classes.name: Maintenance
key_classes.responsibility: Countdown thread broadcasting maintenance warnings and triggering ServerManager.gI().close().

key_classes.name: Manager
key_classes.responsibility: Central static registry for templates, maps, clans, shops, server config properties, and leaderboard SQL queries.

key_classes.name: MenuController
key_classes.responsibility: Handles NPC menu open and option selection with distance/anti-spam checks and trade cancellation.

key_classes.name: IServerPacketHandler
key_classes.responsibility: Interface for modular server packet handlers decoupled from Controller.

key_classes.name: ServerTradePacketHandler
key_classes.responsibility: Handles opcode -86 by delegating to TransactionService.gI().controller.

key_classes.name: ServerItemPacketHandler
key_classes.responsibility: Handles opcode -20 (pick item) by delegating to ItemMapService.gI().pickItem.

key_classes.name: PacketProfiler
key_classes.responsibility: Tracks per-opcode latency metrics, logs slow packets asynchronously, exports CSV summaries, and writes PERFORMANCE_ALERTS.json.

key_classes.name: ServerManager
key_classes.responsibility: Application entrypoint, lifecycle orchestrator, IP connection limiter, auto-save/daily-reset scheduler, and graceful shutdown.

key_classes.name: ServerNotify
key_classes.responsibility: Background thread broadcasting queued VIP announcements (cmd 93) and sending notification tabs (cmd 50).

module_summary: Core server lifecycle, game loop, packet routing/profiling, and static registry layer in src/server/ and src/server/network/. Controller remains a large God-class handler with only opcodes -86 and -20 extracted to ServerPacketDispatcher, while PacketProfiler measures every packet in Controller's finally block. ServerManager orchestrates Netty startup, background tournament/event services, BCrypt migration, auto-save, daily reset, and shutdown; GameLoopManager runs fixed-rate player, zone, boss, and dungeon ticks; Manager holds static game templates, maps, clans, and leaderboard queries.

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Dispatches trade (-86) to TransactionService and item pickup (-20, readShort itemMapId) to ItemMapService; dead duplicate switch cases remain in Controller.

Consign shop: readByte action; case 0 reads short idItem, byte moneyType, int money, int/byte quantity (version>=222); cases 1/2/5 readShort; case 3 readShort+readByte+readInt; case 4 readByte+readByte.
Radar: readByte actionRadar (checks available<1); case 1 checks available<2 and readShort idC.

MagicTree (byte), PetStatus (byte), Buy (byte, short), Sell (byte, byte, short), ChangeZone (byte), ChatGlobal (UTF), PlayerMenu (int), SkillShortcut (10x byte with IOException fallback), Flag (byte act, optional byte).
Move: readByte b, readShort toX, optional readShort toY; throttled 80ms and distance-checked unless TDLT or isNearMobInZone.
Res download (byte), Combine (byte + byte len + len*byte), Icon (int), ImgByName (UTF), EffTemplate (short), FlagBag (byte), EffFlag (byte), BGTemplate (short), DauThan menu (byte, byte).

SkillNotFocus (byte+service), ClanMemberList (int), ClanList (UTF), Caption (byte), Capsule/BlackBall map (byte), MobTemplate (byte), Command (UTF), MenuSelect (short, byte), MenuOpen (short), SelectSkill (short), AttackMob (byte mobId, optional int masterId), AttackPlayer (int playerId).

NotLogin (-29: subcmd 0 login UTF/UTF, 1 regis, 2 clientType); NotMap (-28: subcmd 2 createChar UTF/byte/byte, 6/7/8 updates, 10 mapTemp unsignedByte, 13 joinMap); SubCommand (-30: 16/18 increasePoint byte/short, 64 subMenu int/short).
Opcode 93 writes UTF VIP broadcast to all players; Opcode 50 writes byte count then (short index, UTF title, UTF content) per Manager.NOTIFY entry.
